subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A device that converts electrical energy into sound by using an electromagnet to repeatedly attract and release a metal hammer, causing it to strike a gong, is the:
explanation: An electric bell uses an electromagnet's on-off attraction cycle (via a self-interrupting contact) to repeatedly strike a hammer against a gong — distinct from an electric motor (converts electrical energy into continuous rotational motion) or a generator (converts mechanical motion into electricity, the reverse process).

subject: Environmental Studies
stem: An electric motor and an electric generator both use electromagnetism but perform opposite energy conversions. An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical motion, while a generator converts:
explanation: A generator converts mechanical energy (rotation) into electrical energy via electromagnetic induction — the reverse of a motor, which converts electrical energy into mechanical rotation — distinct from a battery/cell (chemical to electrical) or a solar cell (light to electrical).
